note: According to Hill's 1922 original English description (published as Hamitermes darwini n.sp., later transferred to Amitermes); it describes the soldier and the worker, the measurements being those of the type series; the PDF text layer had one word per line and has been normalised and checked.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The original was published as a new species, Hamitermes darwini. Soldier: mandibles very long, sickle-shaped, each with one large tooth level with the apex of the labrum; labrum large, wide at the base, the sides slightly rounded to a broadly rounded apex, the apex barely covering the mandibular teeth, with about 14 long red hairs; pronotum very small, much narrower than the head, the anterior half upturned, the anterior margin semicircular with a faint median notch. Worker: anterior margin of the pronotum without a notch.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: In side view the head curves continuously from the fontanelle to the occiput, the curvature shallower anteriorly; mandibles very long, wide at the base, incurved at the apex; the narrowest part of the postmentum about 1/4 of the head width. Antennae 15-segmented: segment 1 very large, segment 2 about half the length of segment 1 and much narrower, both bare, segment 3 shortest (about half of segment 2), segment 4 slightly larger than segment 5, segment 6 slightly larger than segment 4, segments 7—14 elongated. Legs rather short, the femora and fore tibiae slightly stout, the posterior margin of the apical 1/3 of the tibia with long stout setae. Measurements: total length 4.25 mm; head length with mandibles 2.35, from the base to the apex of the labrum 1.88, width 1.22—1.36, thickness 0.89; antennal length 1.88; pronotum length 0.387, width 0.70; hind tibia length 1.22; abdominal width 1.17.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Coloration: head ochre yellow, the sides tinged ochre orange; clypeus and labrum ochre yellow; frons milky white; the rest pale yellow. Head small, semicircular posteriorly, slightly widened laterally to the mandibular base, antennal sockets wide and shallow; postclypeus large, length about half its width, convex, broadly rounded posteriorly, truncate anteriorly, with a distinct suture; labrum short and wide, anterior margin rounded; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest; pronotum similar to that of the soldier but without a notch on the anterior margin; legs short and stout, tibial spurs 3:2:2. Measurements: total length 4.25 mm; head length 1.55, width 1.22; thorax and abdomen together 3.80.
